purpose: Compare the relationship between capacity15 and actual utilization10 using fixed v15 trajectories, without changing any economic rule or fitting new national targets.
design_type: Retrospective paired score replay on previously seen v15 validation data; not a fresh holdout.

definitions.u: Unique own-origin born>0 units ever used domestically or abroad / max(1,all own-origin born>0 units)
use_exclusions: foreign-origin imports from this producer numerator
repeat durable use or resale multiplication
definitions.not_unused_inventory: Owned unused inventory can include imports and gifts; it is not produced-minus-used.

reweight.role: Move5 points from capacity to usage

partial.role: Link5 of the15 capacity points to overall actual use

comparison_groups.controls: Each stress behavior paired with same-mode same-seed stress normal; main100 kept separate.

primary_diagnostics: Investment amount up, unique used own output not up, total score up: diagnostic flag, not proof of waste.
Investment strategy paired score and component changes, with actual use, produced units, cash, unused inventory, satisfaction and useful trade.
Trade strategy paired total and industry changes, including capacity progress intentionally forgone.
Public1G and passive-public1G positive-score exceptions: inspect actual usage, useful exports, capacity and all components.
Idle total up count. Automatic production/income still operate; human inaction not fully represented.
Per-country main mean, top count including ties, actual q/u and mean within-game max-minus-min range. Equal top counts are not a goal.
structural_checks: All scores bounded, finite, source baseline exactly reproduced, non-industry components unchanged.
At fixed q and production, more actually used units never reduces industry points.
At fixed q and used count, extra unused production never increases points.
At fixed u, additional target progress never reduces points.
q=u=1 gives25 for all; q=u=0 gives0; P=0 impliesu=0.
Constructed final states demonstrate that even full coupling may reward more capacity with unchanged used units.
Initial stock/import/repeated use exclusions checked against266 saved detailed unit traces.
decision_rules: No country-specific new coefficients, target refitting or equal-win matching.
Prefer the least complicated, least disruptive candidate only if behavior diagnostics and national opportunity costs justify it. A smaller range alone is insufficient.
Preserve15/10 display for partial/full, explicitly disclose5-point or15-point use linkage. Reweight changes the prior split and remains a candidate.
No claim that capacity-linked usage measures causal use of new machinery.
No automatic penalty for low prices; a positive score with real consumption/export gain is not automatically a bug.
If coupling amplifies existing low-utilization country disadvantage or risky low-price incentives, retain the prior baseline rather than forcing adoption.
Candidate assessment is provisional because AI policies do not optimize the revised score.
limits: No new economic simulations;2180 prior games replayed once into4 score views.
No score-aware strategic optimization, human3student80minute or livecloudtest.
Same-unit aggregation across goods; fixed-price capacity weights and equal-unit utilization differ.
Round9 production has fewer usage opportunities; first use of durable counts once and productive-service duration is not measured.
Aggregates cannot assign use to particular expansion; detailedtrace evidence266 only.
Development raw-material consumption is real use, not proof of beneficial development.
Seed intervals describe fixed-policy variation, not confidence about student behavior.
stop_rule: After semantic tests, frozen replay,68groups/64behavior/204view comparisons, independent formula and trace audit, report number QA, save artifacts. Do not retune coefficients or rerun economies to seek a favorable result.
